responsibility: This file implements GCC’s GIMPLE vtable verification instrumentation pass for the C++ virtual table pointer security feature enabled by -fvtable-verify. Using the class-to-vtable-map data structures declared in vtable-verify.h and populated elsewhere from class hierarchy information, it scans SSA GIMPLE basic blocks for virtual-call setup sequences, identifies the loaded vptr and the static class type involved, and inserts calls to the runtime verifier (__VLTVerifyVtablePointer, with optional debug-string arguments) immediately before the virtual dispatch uses the pointer. It therefore owns the per-function middle-end transformation that turns compile-time knowledge of valid vtable sets into runtime checks, updating SSA after rewriting uses of the original vtable-pointer SSA name.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/vtable-verify.h, which declares the shared class/vtable map data structures and lookup APIs used across the feature, this source file implements the per-function GIMPLE instrumentation pass that finds virtual-call vptr loads and inserts __VLTVerifyVtablePointer checks before dispatch.
